extracted.name: Pan-Fried Butter Beans
extracted.description: Chef John's butter beans recipe features creamy butter beans pan-fried with garlic, fresh rosemary, and a pinch of pepper flakes for a little heat.
ingredient_lines: 1 (15 ounce) can butter beans - drained, rinsed, and patted dry
1 pinch red pepper flakes, or more to taste
salt and ground black pepper to taste
instruction_lines: Heat oil in a nonstick skillet over medium-low heat. Add beans; cook and stir until slightly golden and crispy, about 10 minutes.
Stir in garlic, rosemary, pepper flakes, salt, and pepper and continue cooking until crispy, about 5 minutes.
Discard garlic and stir in vinegar.
